name: cloak
description: MCP-native secrets vault. Raw stored secrets are not returned as MCP tool output.
long_description:
Cloak replaces the anti-pattern of pasting API keys into prompts with a hardened local daemon that never returns raw stored secret values to the model. Agents call action-shaped MCP tools (sign_request, proxy_authenticated_http_request, mint_short_lived_token) and the daemon performs the privileged operation on the agent's behalf. Derived tokens and proxied upstream responses are still visible to the MCP client by design. Reveal is a deliberate user-presence-gated CLI act, not a tool call.

This extension bundles the cloak-mcp shim. It requires the cloak CLI + cloakd daemon to be installed and set up separately (see https://github.com/cloakward/cloak#install). Run `cloak setup` in a terminal first so Cloak can safely display and verify the one-time recovery seed, then run `cloak daemon start` and `cloak unlock`. Restart Claude Desktop after the daemon is running and unlocked.

tools.name: list_secret_names
tools.description: List the names and metadata of secrets stored in the local Cloak vault. Returns names, kinds, and tags only — never the secret values themselves.

tools.name: get_secret_metadata
tools.description: Return metadata about a single named secret (kind, tags, created/updated timestamps, version). Never returns the secret value.

tools.name: sign_request
tools.description: Compute authentication headers for an outbound HTTP request using a stored secret as the signing key. Supports AWS SigV4 and generic HMAC-SHA256. Returns only the computed headers — the underlying secret is never disclosed.

tools.name: proxy_authenticated_http_request
tools.description: Perform an authenticated HTTPS request via the daemon, attaching a stored secret as bearer, basic, or custom-header auth to the outbound request. Allowlisted hosts only. Returns status, redacted headers, and base64 body; query-string auth is disabled. The stored secret is not returned to the MCP client.

tools.name: mint_short_lived_token
tools.description: Mint a short-lived derived token from a long-lived parent secret. AWS STS is implemented; GitHub App and GitLab PAT kinds are reserved and currently return not-supported. Returns the derived token and its expiry. The long-lived parent never leaves the daemon.

tools.name: query_audit
tools.description: Query the local Cloak audit log of privileged operations. Filterable by time range, tool name, secret name, and result. Returns audit entries — never secret values.
